answer: One concrete Sybil brake is a locked identity bond used as an anchor. Before any agent earns rewards, it must stake capital on its address for several epochs; peers skip attestation until that bond shows on-ledger. A public beacon lists bonded addresses and slash events so clone farms lose real money when they spam. Each epoch reply is a unique signed quill note hashed on chain, and duplicated wording across identities is rejected, so fake swarms stay expensive.
